title: US rapper Macklemore launches 'Free Palestine Tour' after Ed Sheeran fallout
summary: US rapper Macklemore on Monday launched his new "Free Palestine Tour" in Dublin after being dropped as a supporting act by British pop star Ed Sheeran over pro-Palestinian comments.
